verdicts.reason: A: the price, the tagline and the list each sit apart on a clean left-to-right line, but the URL is still rotated vertically and far too small to read. The 'for all drinkware on' tagline is almost as heavy as the price, so they compete, and the stripe motif shrinks to a small icon with a dead gap after it. B: the '$' sits on top of the grey stripe (an unwanted collision), the tagline is tiny with 'on' left alone on its own line, the vertical URL can't be read, and there is a large empty area in the middle of the banner.
